Interface HoldDailyTotalJpaRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<HoldDailyTotal, Integer>, HoldDailyTotalJpaRepositoryCustom, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<HoldDailyTotal, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<HoldDailyTotal, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<HoldDailyTotal, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<HoldDailyTotal, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<HoldDailyTotal>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<HoldDailyTotal, Integer>
public interface HoldDailyTotalJpaRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<HoldDailyTotal, Integer>, HoldDailyTotalJpaRepositoryCustom
Daily total value per tenant and portfolio. Written only by the task HOLD_DAILY_TOTAL_UPDATE; no REST repository is exposed. Consumers should prefer the methods of HoldDailyTotalJpaRepositoryCustom, which also report from which day the rows may be outdated or missing.

    • getEarliestChangedQuoteDateByTenant

      @Query(nativeQuery=true) LocalDate getEarliestChangedQuoteDateByTenant(Integer idTenant, LocalDateTime checkedTime)
      Finds the earliest trading day on which a price the tenant depends on was created or changed after the given time. This is the timestamp technique of Transaction.getTransactionWhyHistoryquoteYounger: a back-filled gap, a corrected or reloaded history and a price of the gap filler all leave a younger historyquote.create_modify_time.

      A price counts when the tenant held the instrument on that day: the security itself, the currency pair converting a position into the tenant or the portfolio currency, or the currency pair converting a cash balance. The periodic prices of historyquote_period carry no timestamp and are not covered.

      Named query: HoldDailyTotal.getEarliestChangedQuoteDateByTenant Parameters in SQL: - ?1 - the tenant, applied to hold_securityaccount_security and hold_cashaccount_balance - ?2 - the time of the previous scan; only prices with a younger create_modify_time are considered Each of the five branches joins one id column of a hold table to historyquote, so that the lookup uses the unique key (id_securitycurrency, date) instead of scanning the price table by its timestamp.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant
      checkedTime - the time of the previous scan
      Returns:
      the earliest affected day, or null when no such price exists

    • getFirstHoldDatePerTenantBySecurity

      @Query(nativeQuery=true) List<HoldDailyTotalJpaRepository.ITenantFirstHoldDate> getFirstHoldDatePerTenantBySecurity(Integer idSecuritycurrency)
      Lists for every tenant holding a security the first day it held it. A rebuild of the holdings of that security, after a split was added, changed or removed, can change every day of those hold periods. Named query: HoldDailyTotal.getFirstHoldDatePerTenantBySecurity Parameters in SQL: - ?1 - the security
      Parameters:
      idSecuritycurrency - the security
      Returns:
      one row per tenant
